# Kenney Fantasy Town Kit 2.0 — curated subset

- Author: Kenney
- Official page: https://kenney.nl/assets/fantasy-town-kit
- Downloaded: 2026-10-26
- License: Creative Commons CC0 1.0; the original `LICENSE.txt` is stored beside this file.
- Original package: `kenney_fantasy-town-kit_2.0.zip`

Only the five pieces used on Michael Island are kept: the rim balustrade panel and posts
(`balcony-wall-fence`, `pillar-stone`), gate and pier lanterns (`lantern`), and the Convergence
Altar basin (`fountain-round-detail`, `fountain-center`).
